info.name: Send Outs (Census + APV)
info.description:
# Send Outs API

Census-backed send-out generate/delete. Source lines come from `mytemr_reports.sendout_census`. GET endpoints omit `branch_id` to union all diagnostic DBs. Generate groups `entries[]` by `branch_id` and writes one header per branch.

## Auth
- Header: `API-KEY` (required)
- Body/query: `token`, `requester` (required on all endpoints)

## Request body format
- **GET** — query params
- **POST** (generate / upload_attachment / delete) — **multipart form-data** (do not set `Content-Type` manually; Postman sets the boundary)
- Nested `entries` use PHP-style bracket keys so `getVar()` receives an array

## Branch map (diagnostic DBs)
- `1` mobile
- `2` oakridge (`mytemr_diagnostic`)
- `3` mactan
- `4` consolacion
- `7` mantlewood

## Methods
`get`, `get_all_transaction`, `get_transaction`, `generate`, `upload_attachment`, `delete`

## Attachments
Generate accepts optional multipart `attachments[]`. `upload_attachment` adds files to an existing send_out. Files are uploaded to VM4 under `assets/send_outs/{send_out_id}/`. GET returns nested `attachments`. Delete soft-deletes them with the header.

## `facility_id` on generate
Header `facility_id` is optional. Default is the unique facility IDs from that branch group, comma-separated.

## APV
`accounts_payable_vouchers/get_all_for_apv` includes type `send_out`.
- `amount` = `send_out.total_expense`
- `supplier_type` = `supplier`
- Eligible rows are live send_outs with no APV (`type=send_out`, `type_id=send_out.id`)

query.description: Omit to UNION ALL five diagnostic send_out tables
for_apv = no APV yet; apv = has accounts_payable_voucher type=send_out

request.description:
## GET `/send_outs/get`

Reads `send_out` from the diagnostic DB for `branch_id`. If `branch_id` is omitted, unions all five diagnostic databases.

### Status
- `for_apv` — send_out rows with **no** `accounts_payable_voucher` (`type=send_out`, `type_id=send_out.id`, `is_deleted=0`)
- `apv` — send_out rows that **have** that APV

### Optional filters
- `send_out_id`, `supplier_id`, `page` + `data_size`

Each row includes nested `entries`, `attachments`, and `facility_names` (resolved from the comma-separated header `facility_id`).

### Success
```json
{
  "size": 1,
  "data": [{
    "id": 1,
    "branch_id": 2,
    "facility_id": "3,5",
    "supplier_id": 94,
    "due_date": "2026-09-30",
    "total_sales": "1500.0000",
    "total_expense": "900.0000",
    "status": "for_apv",
    "accounts_payable_voucher_id": null,
    "supplier_name": "Chong Hua Hospital",
    "facility_names": "CHONG HUA HOSPITAL CEBU, Other Facility",
    "entries": []
  }]
}
```

request.description:
## GET `/send_outs/get_all_transaction`

Reads `{REPORTS_DB}.sendout_census` (same joins as `reports/get_sendout_census`: patient_name, facility, supplier_id, lab_test).

Excludes rows whose `id` is already on a live `send_out_entry.sendout_census_id` in **any** of the five diagnostic DBs.

All filters optional: `branch_id`, `date`, `date_from` + `date_to` (`sendout_census.date`), `facility_id`, `supplier_id`, `term`, pagination. Each row includes `transaction_no`.

query.description: Optional. Omit to union unused census across all diagnostic DBs.
Optional. Omit to return all unused lines for the branch+supplier so FE can collect facility IDs for generate.

request.description:
## GET `/send_outs/get_transaction`

Same unused-census query as `get_all_transaction`, then filters:
- `supplier_id` **required**
- `branch_id` optional (omit to union all diagnostic DBs)
- `facility_id` optional
- `date_from` + `date_to` optional (`sendout_census.date`)

If `facility_id` is omitted, unused lines for the supplier (and optional branch) are returned so FE can collect facility IDs and pass `entries[n][branch_id]` on generate.

formdata.description: Optional override. Default is unique facility_ids from each branch group.
Optional. Uploaded to VM4 at assets/send_outs/{send_out_id}/. pdf, png, jpeg, jpg.

request.description:
## POST `/send_outs/generate`

Body: **form-data** (multipart). Header `branch_id` is **not** used. Entries are grouped by `entries[n][branch_id]`; one `send_out` is written on each diagnostic DB.

### Required header
- `supplier_id`, `due_date`, `invoice_no`, `invoice_date`
- `facility_id` optional override (otherwise unique facility IDs from that branch group)
- Header `total_sales` / `total_expense` are not stored per branch; each header uses the sum of its group entries
- `entries[]`

### Required per entry
`branch_id`, `sendout_census_id`, `date`, `facility_id`, `transaction_id`, `patient_id`, `service_id`  
Optional: `total_sales`, `total_expense` (default 0).

Rejects if any `sendout_census_id` is already on a live `send_out_entry`.
Optional `attachments[]` files are uploaded to VM4 for **each** created header.

### Success
```json
{ "send_out_ids": [{ "branch_id": 2, "send_out_id": 15 }], "message": "send_out generated successfully." }
```

response.name: Census already saved

formdata.description: Required. Uploaded to VM4 at assets/send_outs/{send_out_id}/. pdf, png, jpeg, jpg.

request.description:
## POST `/send_outs/upload_attachment`

Adds files to an **existing** send_out. Required: `branch_id`, `send_out_id`, `attachments[]`.

Uploads to VM4 (`assets/send_outs/{send_out_id}/`). Allowed: pdf, png, jpeg, jpg. Returns the full live attachments list.

## POST `/send_outs/delete`

Soft-deletes the `send_out` header **and** its `send_out_entry` rows (`is_deleted = 1`) on the diagnostic DB for `branch_id`.

Refuses if a live APV exists (`type=send_out`, `type_id=send_out_id`).

response.name: Has APV

request.description:
## GET `/accounts_payable_vouchers/get_all_for_apv`

Now includes send outs that have not yet generated an APV.

- `type` = `send_out`
- `type_id` = `send_out.id`
- `amount` = `send_out.total_expense`
- `supplier_type` = `supplier`
- `supplier_id` = `send_out.supplier_id`
- `due_date` = `send_out.due_date`

Create the APV with `type=send_out` and `type_id` from this list.
